ML-ready pipeline

Source: R/pipeline.R
pipeline_ml_ready.Rd

Strict pipeline + business normalisations + optional currency conversion.

Usage

pipeline_ml_ready(
  data,
  required_columns = NULL,
  strict = TRUE,
  normalize = TRUE,
  do_currency = TRUE,
  finalize = FALSE,
  dedup_keys = NULL,
  dedup_keep = c("first", "last"),
  cap_col = "salary_in_usd",
  cap_lower = 0.01,
  cap_upper = 0.99,
  cap_side = c("both", "upper", "lower"),
  cap_verbose = FALSE,
  check_ranges = TRUE,
  ranges_min_year = 2000,
  ranges_max_year = as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")),
  impute_verbose = FALSE,
  cat_constant = "NA"
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame.

required_columns

Optional character vector of required columns.

strict

Stop on missing required columns when TRUE (default).

normalize

Logical. Apply normalize_all when all expected columns are present.

do_currency

Logical. Apply convert_currency_to_usd (default TRUE).

dedup_keys, dedup_keep, cap_col, cap_lower, cap_upper, cap_side, cap_verbose

See pipeline_strict_clean().

check_ranges, ranges_min_year, ranges_max_year

See pipeline_strict_clean().

impute_verbose, cat_constant

See pipeline_strict_clean().

Value

A fully cleaned data.frame ready for modelling.
